sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Signs.com offers custom signs, banners, decals, and signages with free design services and next day production.

Industry: Printing and Promotional Products · Size: <$50M · Products: Custom Signs, Banners, Decals, Vinyl Banners, Acrylic Signs, A-Frame Signs

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Signs.com scores 53 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30), event engagement (15/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on cleanability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar surfaces clean up with mild detergent, no abrasives, no gloss loss. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (38% similar on vinyl, signage, vehicle, durable); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (29% similar on vinyl, vehicle, window, fleet); Drytac (17% similar on print, vinyl, graphic, sign). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
